children: Catcher Predict reported sharp volatility in a Polymarket submarket tied to the "LoL Solary vs. G2 NORD EMEA Masters playoff" event. According to ChainCatcher, the "Yes" option for the submarket "both teams kill Baron Nashor" jumped from 0.5% one hour earlier to 47% at the time of monitoring, a 46.5% increase. The move was flagged as being affected by breaking news.

title: Catcher Predict: Polymarket Odds for Solary vs. G2 NORD EMEA Masters Playoff Submarket Surge to 47%
